_comment: REGISTRATION PAGE COPY (English). PLACEHOLDER CONTENT — the user explicitly asked for placeholders here on 2026-08-11 pending a detailed file they're sending with the real track names/count and real Google Form links. Everything under 'forms' below (track names, count of 3, and every openHref='#') is a stand-in, not real data — replace all of it once that file arrives; don't treat any of these specific values as confirmed. The deadline mentioned in 'deadlineNote' IS real (matches src/_data/copy/home.en.json's countdown, set in Phase 1). Structure/pattern otherwise copied from submissions.en.json — one form per 'track', same card+copy-link+noscript-fallback UI, since registration here means 'register your team for a track', analogous to Submissions' 'submit your project'.
